notes.title: Version 1.0.257.128 has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26700526/aed1aaaf66b6f4cda920862c09eda49998a96214.png[/img]
The left is new mode view, the right is player view

New Features:

*Add one advanced recording mode – Spectator Mode。
One extra camera is added in VR application for the new mode. You can freely set its position and rotation. In spectator mode you can record both original first person view and the new freely configured spectator view.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26700526/aa6914834104115d040180046d907ccd76d8943e.png[/img]
Spectator Mode is in Beta now. Functions and limitations for this release version listed below.
1. Functions
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26700526/495eb3cc054fa21480f89ca6d4f8a2503cad44cc.png[/img]
1.1  Move position of the new added camera.
Click and drag slider at Position Control area using mouse. You can move the camera to any position inside the running VR application. The moving distance is unlimited. You can move towards left, right, up, down, forward and backward freely to your expected position.
1.2  Rotate the new added camera
Click and drag slider at Rotation Control area using mouse. You can rotate the camera. The limitation is 180° if turning left or right and 90° if turning up or down.

2. Limitations
　　2.1 Support 64 bit operating system only now.
　　2.2 Support HTC Vive device only.
2.3 Support VR application using unity engine only. If you find any unity VR application not supported please leave a message to us.
　　2.4 Known issues and solutions
　　	a. An extra Vive controller icon appears in the SteamVR UI.
		Expected. We add a vive virtual controller technically for the extra camera. When you open spectator mode one more vive controller icon will be added. It will probably not bring side effect to your experience of VR application. If you do not want to see it any more, restart SteamVR application.
　　b. When recording in spectator mode, the window of VR application in the computer screen is divided into four sub windows.
　　Expected. And it will not impact the playing experience with the Vive HMD on.
　　c. Spectator view disappeared suddenly 
　　Either or both of the two physical vive controllers run abnormally including powering off, entering standby mode and losing tracking by vive base station. Power on and take the two Vive controllers into the tracking area again is required.
　　d. Spectator view is controlled by a physical vive controller
　　The two physical vive controllers must be kept powering on and tracking by base station on spectator mode. The situation generally caused by controller powering off and on, or tracking lost and resume. It made the running virtual controller taking over the abnormal physical controller，and later the resumed physical controller take over the virtual controller. Restart the running VR application may fix the issue.

notes.title: Version 1.0.241.128 has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26700526/59dc18c67ae1fa2f8f473e88faf2cbb8912a588a.png[/img]* Add a new video editor, after you have just recorded the VR game videos, you can right-click on the video, and select Edit menu to enter the editor.  
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26700526/ffabf8ee9ba990c6c274089026222ddce12f8593.png[/img]         
  The editor is currently in the Beta phase, the first version supports the following two features,           
  1. Make your own Animated GIF , GIF is becoming more and more popular in our social life. You can select different size of the GIF, large, medium and small, which will be adjusted according to the video resolution,           
    At the same time, you can also choose High Quality Gif to generate a high quality GIF, but the file size will be larger.           
   After have selected the video time period, you can preview the generated GIF, and then decide whether to use the Export button to save it.          
  2 Make a video clip, select the start and end time, you can save the selected video segment to clip.           
    You can use the slider to select the time period, or manually input the start time and end time.           
  After have finished edited the video, you can share the video to Youtube or Tencent.

Any suggestions are appreciated!
Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Picture in Picture mode has been released!
notes.notes:
From version 1.0.197.128, VRCapture can record in PIP Mode(Picture in Picture mode)

    Now, we have added a new recording mode which is called PIP Mode(Picture in Picture mode).    

     Picture in Picture mode is one of the most popular video recording form.
The background scene is the VR Game picture, and in its front is the webcam video image.
You can drag the webcam video picture to change the position in the whole video and its size. 
You should adjust the webcam video position and size according to different games.

    Besides the new features of recording mode, we have fixed some minor bugs and improved the 
recording experience. 
    	
    We will add more attractive features in the next versions(such as 360 degree video recording).
    Any suggestions and feedback are appreciated.

notes.title: VRCapture is now support Single Eye Recording
notes.notes:
From version 1.0.166.128, VRCapture can record single eye recordings. 

    Differ from VR recording, it makes a 2D plane video, which does not contain immersive experience, and can not view with cardboard. But most people are common with this format of videos.

    When begin to record, first run VRCapture from SteamVR, then run the VR game or application which you want to record,
select different record mode from right Record Panel of VRCapture. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26700526/db4b3ed2d870fcc64a17ea971fd8bf3e394f4e2c.png[/img]

    It contains two mode until now. VR Mode is the important feature of VRCapture, which can record the displays of HMD. Normal Mode is the so called single eye recording.

    After record mode is selected, you can click Start Record Button or press the default hotkey Ctrl+F12(maybe your custom hotkey which can be set in the setting tab window) to start recording. It will display a animation on the left corner window of the VR game or application, which shows the recording time.

    The videos which are recorded with VR Mode will have a cardboard view logo on the right bottom of the video thumbnails, while Normal Mode videos don't have.

    For the best experience, we have been tried a lot of game recordings, finally we decided that when recorded with Normal Mode, VRCapture will produce the same resolution video with the VR game. You can adjust the game window size for the best effect.

    We will add more attractive features in the next versions.

    Any suggestions and feedbacks are appreciated.
